Product Overview

Europull Grade 80 alloy steel chains are designed for heavy lifting slings, hoist drive mechanisms, marine lashing, and offshore rigging operations.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Alloy steel chain are available?

The Europull Alloy steel chain is available in 9 models: 6.0 mm, 7.1 mm, 8.0 mm, 10.0 mm, 13.0 mm, 16.0 mm, 20.0 mm, 22.0 mm, 32.0 mm. Pitch (mm) ranges from 18.0 mm to 96.0 mm. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

Which standard does the Europull Alloy steel chain comply with?

The Europull Alloy steel chain is manufactured to EN 818-2 / EN 818-7.

What chain Grade does the Europull Alloy steel chain have?

The Europull Alloy steel chain's chain Grade: Grade 80 (T-Class) & Grade 100 (V-Class).

What material does the Europull Alloy steel chain have?

The Europull Alloy steel chain's material: Special Nickel-Chromium-Molybdenum Alloy Steel.

What safety Factor does the Europull Alloy steel chain have?

The Europull Alloy steel chain's safety Factor: 4:1 (Slings / Hoists).
